rationale: The stock gapped 27% on 255x relative volume with no identifiable news catalyst, making the durability of this move unknowable — it could be a legitimate catalyst or a coordinated pump. The most recent 5-minute candle reversed sharply from the $13.76 high back to $13.25 below the 5-minute VWAP of $13.36, suggesting early exhaustion, but the 98-bps spread and lack of any fundamental context make clean risk definition impossible for either a long continuation or short fade. With no historical comparable setups, no borrow rate data, and a wide spread that would eat significantly into any edge, the information quality is insufficient to justify capital commitment.
